pretrain_resolved.architecture: per-lead VGG16(alpha=0.125, trc=1 GRN1D, fc=Identity) x8; projector 64-2048-2048-2048 (Linear no-bias + BN + ReLU, last Linear no-bias); output BN BatchNorm1d(2048, affine=False) per lead
pretrain_resolved.loss: LFBT Barlow Twins: per lead-pair recompute BN, C=c1.T@c2/batch_size, on=(diag-1)^2, off=lambd*offdiag^2, loss=gamma*loss_r+(1-gamma)*loss_t
pretrain_resolved.optimizer: Adam(lr=1e-3, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, wd=0); param order = weights(ndim>1) then biases(ndim==1) across backbone,projector,bn,rr_head (run_pt 同口径)
pretrain_resolved.init: from scratch per seed; set_seed(seed) before construction; construction order backbone->projector->bn->rr_head 保证共享部分初始指纹跨配方一致
pretrain_resolved.sample_order: per-epoch permutation via torch.Generator seeded by blake2b(f'perm|{seed}|{epoch}'); 同 seed 跨配方逐位一致; drop_last=True

global_views.pipeline: NSTDB NoiseInjector -> RRC-TO (源码 Compose 顺序); ToTensor
global_views.rng: per-(seed,epoch,record,view g1/g2) blake2b 流(det-aug-v1); 分布与抽样顺序与源代码一致, 机制从 worker 全局 RNG 改为逐记录确定流; 保证跨配方一致与断点续训复现

aux_resolved.I1_I2_template: 全部有效缓存峰取窗后逐点 mean(I1)/median(I2); 一致性=复刻 _dv_consistency(逐对重算BN, on-diag, 两整段视图平均)
aux_resolved.I3_peaks_selection: K=min(峰数,8); 超过8按有序峰索引 round(linspace(0,P-1,8))
aux_resolved.local_views: 同一组原始窗两份, 各自仅 NoiseInjector(prob0.5), 无时间裁剪/平移/翻转; RNG=(seed,epoch,record,loc{j}v{1,2}) 独立于整段流
aux_resolved.local_objective: 共享 backbone+projector; 权重 w_bj=1/(N_valid*K_b); 加权标准化 sqrt(var+1e-4); C=Z1s.T diag(w) Z2s; 逐导联 on=(diag-1)^2 + 0.0051*off^2; 八导联平均; N_valid<2 跳过该批局部项并计数; padding 窗(峰近边界)按 edge 填充后照常入行
aux_resolved.rr: rr_head=Linear(64,32)+ReLU+Linear(32,3), 输入视图1首导(II) 64维GAP特征; 目标 [mean_RR,SDNN,RMSSD] 秒, 全库 z-score (mu/sd 实测见 data_manifest)

pretrain_resolved.checkpoint_selection: 固定最后 epoch 导出编码器; 每 epoch 保存完整恢复状态

lp_resolved.data: P0 隔离 train4809/val683 (SHA 见 data_manifest); 九类 multihot 原始顺序
lp_resolved.features: 共同整段编码器 8x64=512 维, eval+冻结
lp_resolved.head: Linear(512,9); BCEWithLogitsLoss; Adam(lr1e-3,b(0.9,0.999),eps1e-8,wd0)
lp_resolved.selection: 严格最小元素加权 val BCE, 平局取更早 epoch

decision_rules.primary: validation macro average_precision_score over fixed nine classes
decision_rules.reference: I0 with matching PT budget and seed
decision_rules.R2: at most top two positive among I1,I2,I3 each +RR0.1; one remaining nonpositive morphology +RR opportunity, document complementarity; if all negative best morphology +RR once
decision_rules.R3: best positive config, only dominant morphology/local weight x0.3/x3; if RR-only use 0.03/0.3; reuse x1; no positive means no sweep
decision_rules.R4: up to top two positive recipes plus I0, all complete seeds2/4; I5 is eligible
decision_rules.R5: best positive three-seed mean recipe plus I0 at100ep seeds0/2/4; launch only if time/resources permit; no FT or external test expansion
decision_rules.all_negative: allow specified single complementary combo; then conclude valid negative if still nonpositive
